title: Asahi Holdings (Australia) Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of P&N Beverages Australia Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC timeline suspended to await further information from merger parties. Former proposed decision date of 27 October 2010 delayed.
ACCC received further information from merger parties. ACCC timeline recommenced.
ACCC published a Statement of Issues outlining preliminary competition concerns.
Closing date for submissions relating to Statement of Issues.
ACCC requested further information from Asahi. ACCC timeline suspended.
ACCC received further information from Asahi. ACCC timeline recommenced.
ACCC requested further information from Asahi. Former proposed decision date of 24 February 2011 delayed. ACCC timeline suspended pending receipt.
ACCC received further information from Asahi. ACCC timeline recommenced.
ACCC announced it would oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Asahi Holdings (Australia) Pty Ltd proposed acquisition of 100% of the shares in P&N Beverages Australia Pty Ltd.
